text:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: spike in gateway 5xx/timeouts across eu-west-1 — paging oncall @Sana P. — channel #incidents created

Sana P.: on it, thanks. seeing alerts in dashboard, pulling scope now. anyone on call for runtime?

Samir K.: I'm here. initial numbers: 5xx rate jumped from 0.6% -> ~6.8% starting ~10:02 UTC. p50 OK, p95/p99 latency climbing. queue_len for batcher-dispatcher climbed from 120 -> 8.2k.

Sana P.: thanks. customer-facing errors?

Samir K.: yes, gateway 502/504s reported to upstream. errors concentrated on requests hitting long-running batches (seq_len > 1024). looks like scheduler can't drain fast enough -> head-of-line backlog.

Alex R.: I can confirm service logs show repeated "batch_dispatch: deadline exceeded" and upstream gateway returning 504. Also seeing many "kvcache lock wait" warnings.

Sana P.: can we get quick triage: is this config/regression or load? any deploys?

DeployBot: deploy/redwood-batcher v3.14 -> v3.15 rolled at 09:50 UTC — no automatic rollback triggered. (tag: deploy-3612349800)

Samir K.: rolling deploy earlier, but health checks passed. load pattern: sudden burst from a partner region -> high concurrency of long-context chat. looks like chronic batching + seq growth. not a straightforward code crash.

Sana P.: mitigation options: 1) enable overflow routing to secondary pool, 2) force eviction of oldest queued batches, 3) temporarily lower max_batch_size or split long requests, 4) throttle partner token rate. which is least risky?

Ivy L.: I'm joining takeover. Sana -> handing to Ivy. Ivy L. taking lead. please @mention me on each action.

Sana P.: handoff ack. Ivy, current recommended order: enable overflow routing -> scale batcher workers -> evict oldest -> throttle client. we can do non-disruptive routing first.

Samir K.: prepared a quick script to flip routing weight: `PATCH /routing/policies` with body to route 30% -> batchers-secondary. sample curl below:

```
curl -X PATCH "https://ops-api.internal/v1/routing" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"policy":"overflow","weight_secondary":30}'
```

Sana P.: go for it, Samir. minimal blast radius.

Samir K.: applied. watching metrics. queue_len dropping from 8200 -> 4100 in ~90s. 5xx rate trending down.

Jen M. (CS): Jen here — CS is getting tickets. can we give a live summary for customers? rough ETA?

Ivy L.: quick summary for CS: transient capacity saturation caused queue buildup in batch dispatcher for long-context requests, some requests timed out at gateway producing 502/504. we've routed traffic to a secondary capacity pool and are scaling workers — visible improvement but still stabilizing. escalation channel will update.

Jen M. (CS): copy. customers asking how many requests impacted. any %?

Samir K.: current impact estimate: peak ~3% of total requests in eu-west-1 hit 5xx/timeout window; primary customer-facing errors concentrated on large-context calls. will refine and post numbers.

Alex R.: scaling batcher now: `kubectl scale deploy batcher --replicas=6` -> `kubectl scale deploy batcher --replicas=12`. scaling finished in ~45s, new workers joined.

Sana P.: nice. after scale + routing, p95 latency dropping. 5xx down to 0.9% and falling. KV lock warnings still present but less frequent.

Ivy L.: next safety steps: 1) enable oldest-job eviction policy to prevent HOL blocking (evict >30s queued), 2) temporarily reduce max_batch_size from 1024 -> 512 for 15m to reduce scheduling tail, 3) open incident status page. Samir, can you run eviction?

Samir K.: running eviction command now:

```
POST /admin/queue/evict?older_than=30
# returns: evicted=1243, freed_slots=1243
```

Samir K.: eviction completed. freed ~1.2k queued slots. immediate drop in head backlog.

Sana P.: switching to conservative batch size now. Samir please set flag in config-store.

Samir K.: flag toggled: max_batch_size=512 (temp). observing scheduler throughput up ~18%.

Ivy L.: customer comms - Jen, please send a brief note: we experienced transient capacity saturation in eu-west-1 causing increased 5xx/timeouts for long-context requests. mitigation: routed traffic, scaled capacity, evicted old queued jobs, lowered batch sizes. services recovering. ETA for full recovery: 30–45 minutes for smoothing.

Jen M. (CS): will send. any affected paid customers we should proactively refund/credit?

Sana P.: let's flag accounts with >1% error spike and loop in acct execs after incident. Jen please compile list once Samir posts the impact table.

Samir K.: posting short impact metrics snapshot:

```
region eu-west-1
window 10:00-10:12 UTC
total_reqs 1,240,000
5xx_count 26,480 (~2.13%)
long_context_reqs 18,500
long_context_5xx 12,300 (~66%)
```

Samir K.: annotations: errors concentrated in long_context bucket. most other traffic unaffected.

Ivy L.: good. telemetry shows error budget breach avoided, but SLA windows touched. we'll keep routing enabled until queues steady for 20m.

Sana P.: monitoring to confirm steady state. binding follow-up actions for postmortem: - analyze root cause: why batcher couldn't handle long-context joint with deploy, - improve autoscale/reset heuristics, - add guardrails to prevent HOL buildup (queue size alarms, auto-evict), - test routing failover in staging.

Alex R.: add quantized-model fallback option too — allow system to route long-context to a lower-cost variant if primary is saturated.

Samir K.: agree. I'll capture metrics and logs for PM. saving relevant logs and snapshotting queue state.

DeployBot: deploy/redwood-batcher v3.15 flagged for investigation (deploy 3612349800). rollback not automated.

Ivy L.: closing the live mitigation phase. traffic and errors stable for 7m. keeping incident channel open for postmortem planning.

Jen M. (CS): update sent to affected customers, compiling list for credits. will coordinate with acct execs.

Sana P.: thanks team. oncall Ivy L. owning follow-up. please add todos to the incident board and assign owners.

Samir K.: uploading event log and graphs to the incident doc now.

OpsBot: Incident resolved (stabilized) — created postmortem ticket PM-INC-3612349999.

Ivy L.: handoff complete. I'll run the RCA writeup and schedule a triage meeting. :thumbsup:
